question: Is the 25-condition periodic suite exactly contained in the frozen 50-condition suite?
answer: YES -- verified against STORED per-condition hashes, not just regenerated ones.

reconstruction_parameters.why: train and eval conditions are drawn SEQUENTIALLY from one generator, so the eval conditions depend on n_train. Rebuilding with the function default n_train=200 yields a DIFFERENT eval suite and produces spurious hash mismatches. The trainer uses n_train=400.
reconstruction_parameters.self_correction: an initial check of mine reported False for every arm; that was my own reconstruction error (default n_train), not a data problem. The stored suites were always correct and identical across SAC and RLPD.

analysis_protocol.learning_curves: frozen 25-condition suite = EVAL_CONDITIONS[:25]. All three training seeds can be scored on it at checkpoint level, giving directly comparable replicated curves.
analysis_protocol.final_performance: frozen 50-condition suite, for the final checkpoint of all six arms
analysis_protocol.no_mixing: n=25 and n=50 results are never combined within one curve

x_axis: online environment interactions is the primary efficiency axis, not wall-clock: RLPD seed 1 carries extra stochastic-evaluation overhead that does not affect its training
